text:
ada: Heads-up: after the RBAC refactor some SAST jobs started failing with KMS decrypt errors. Repro in pipeline #9931.

nate: Can you paste the error?

ada: Log snippet: ```ERROR: artifact fetch failed: 403 Forbidden
caused by: kms:Decrypt denied
file: scanner/fetcher.go:67```

sun: Likely the scanner SA lost keystore:decrypt when we tightened roles. Check IAM audit diff for 2024-06-15T22:58Z.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident created SEC-2024-1012 - "sast pipelines auth failures". Paging: @nate @ada.

nate: Quick mitigation: grant a time-limited decrypt binding with condition `request.time < timestamp("2024-06-16T01:00:00Z")` to unblock CI.

ada: Applied temp binding, pipeline #9931 passed. Exported audit logs and artifacts to s3://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-1012/.

sun: Follow-ups: 1) design scoped role allowing decrypt only for artifact bucket 2) add infra pre-merge IAM simulation test 3) create alert for repeated `kms:Decrypt` failures in SAST/DAST.

nate: I'll open GH issues and a PR for the pre-merge test.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2024-1012 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled 2024-06-17 14:00 UTC.
